theme_strategy: Light mode prioritized. Archetype: Fusion of Swiss Brutalist (Clarity/Authority) & Organic Earthy (Trust/Growth). Avoids generic 'SaaS Blue' to provide a grounded, highly professional, and reassuring experience for job seekers.

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep jump between heading and subheading within 2 Tailwind steps. H1 max size text-4xl to text-5xl.

body.rules: Use for all dense data, tables, and form inputs. High legibility required.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Use p-6, p-8, or p-12.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Ensure all pixels are utilized.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: For the overview screen. Use varied spans (col-span-2 row-span-2 for primary charts, col-span-1 for summary metrics).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center only if it improves visual rhythm.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use border-collapse style layout for tables. Flat solid backgrounds for health/finance/job data, avoid glassmorphism for data clarity. 1px border with subtle shadow for cards.

components_instructions.general: Rely on Shadcn UI components heavily but strip the default Vercel-look. Apply custom flat/crisp styling.
components_instructions.navigation: Visible navigation bar with logo, 3-5 links, and primary CTA. Sticky header must have solid background (bg-white) and z-50. NO transparent backgrounds over content.
components_instructions.cards: Go cardless or flat rectangular. 1px border (border-border), flat background, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form, Checkbox. Left-aligned labels. Use generous padding inside inputs.
components_instructions.tables: Shadcn Table. Use high contrast for text. Status badges should be pill-shaped with subtle background tints.
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Chart components for dashboard analytics. Ensure color-blind-friendly palettes.

interactive_motion.hover_states: Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Button hover states should be a lighter hue of the active state color.
interactive_motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out). DO NOT use transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. When placing text over images/gradients, use text shadow or semi-solid overlays to meet ratios.

testing_guidelines.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='job-match-score-card'.

auth_background.description: White textured paper background for the login/register split screen. Adds organic warmth.

user_avatar.description: Professional female headshot for user profile mockup.

user_avatar_alt.description: Professional male headshot for alternate profile mockup.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth and distinctiveness.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp sharp edges) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Provide empty, loading, and error states using abstract geometric patterns or clean typography instead of generic illustrations.
NEVER use placeholder text or generic urls for images. Use the exact URLs provided in this guideline.

chrome_extension_guidelines.tech: Manifest V3, Vanilla JS. NO React in the extension.
chrome_extension_guidelines.ui_style: Match the dashboard style but scaled down. Use standard system fonts for the extension if custom fonts are too heavy to load, but stick to the color palette.
chrome_extension_guidelines.components: Minimalist form auto-fill popups, clean success toasts, and clear matching percentage ring graphs.
